candidates.passage: When Helm executes a plugin, it passes the outer environment to the plugin, and also injects some additional environment variables. Variables like KUBECONFIG are set for the plugin if they are set in the outer environment. The following variables are guaranteed to be set: HELM_PLUGINS: The path to the plugins directory. HELM_PLUGIN_NAME: The name of the plugin, as invoked by helm. So helm myplug will have the short name myplug. HELM_PLUGIN_DIR: The directory that contains the plugin. HELM_BIN: The path to the helm command (as executed by the user). HELM_DEBUG: Indicates if the debug flag was set by helm. HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG: The location for the registry configuration (if using). Note that the use of Helm with registries is an experimental feature.
